what: PLAN-POLICE-VOICE-KAZE-DETAIL Step P: the patrol car livery band and light bar
machine: the user's Windows 11 PC, Chrome (Claude in Chrome), npm run dev:local
how: Live traffic is rare (police is 1.5/100 spawn weight) and the scramble camera keeps every car small and distant, so the precise before/after colour comparison was done with the exact production code path (buildVehicleShape, fleetGeometry, installLivery, paintOf, liveryCode from src/traffic/fleet.mjs and src/traffic/vehicle-shape.mjs, unmodified) rendered standalone in a same-origin page reached through the dev server, under the exact DAY_NIGHT day/night light constants from src/environment/day-night.mjs. A live in-game screenshot (day-and-night-near-far-taxi-sedan.jpg) was also captured showing the police car beside a taxi and a sedan at the fixed HIGH night settings.

geometry_check.method: buildVehicleShape('police').geometry.body vertex Y values vs LIVERY.police.band*VEHICLES.police.height

before_fix.reads_as: the black/white split sat well below the real beltline, in the lower door -- mostly white with a thin black sliver at the rocker

after_fix.reads_as: black below the beltline (bonnet, bumpers, doors, rocker), white doors-top/pillars/roof, matching the real proportion

night_brightness_probe.method: a single-pixel vertical column straight through the door and roof of the police body mesh alone, lit only by DAY_NIGHT's own HemisphereLight/DirectionalLight intensities, ACESFilmicToneMapping, sRGB output -- no environment map, so the numbers isolate the livery/lighting response only

night.note: the geometry/shader correctly puts the lighter colour above the band and it is clearly not black, but it renders as a mid-grey (~38% of the daytime brightness) rather than a crisp white -- traffic body/dark/glass/front/rear materials are never registered with installNightEmission/DayNightSystem (src/environment/day-night.mjs only matches building/window/ground/sign/train mesh names), so at night they get only the global 8%-intensity key light and 22%-intensity hemisphere fill with no compensating boost. This is a real, separate, secondary contributor to 'looks grey at night' beyond the beltline bug, left unfixed in this step -- see the limitations note.

light_bar.shape: a roof-width bar built from two 12-segment CylinderGeometry lens pieces (its own `lightbar` fleet batch, not the tail lamp) either side of a centre section in the `lamp`/front batch, on a low BoxGeometry mount in `dark`; a pair of small cylinder lamps low in the front grille share the `lightbar` batch
light_bar.draw_calls: traffic-fleet-lightbar is a 6th BatchedMesh; tests/traffic-fleet.test.mjs confirms exactly 6 batches (was 5), i.e. +1, the plan's allowed budget
light_bar.flash: meshes.lightbar gets its own setColorAt in render.mjs's sync(), independent of meshes.rear, so the siren flash no longer forces the tail lamps to the light bar's colour or vice versa

not_checked: hearing the siren/light-bar timing by ear in a live pursuit (needs Step V's loudspeaker work and a real chase)
the light bar viewed from directly behind/in front in motion
a live spawned patrol car at the scramble crossing (police is rare in ordinary traffic; not forced live to avoid leaving the shared dev session in a biased state)
